text:
morgan: Heads-up — opened docs PR #4278 to add a Console migration guide for the new cost breakdown widget. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278. Main changes: new field `cost_source`, small tracing-hook example update, and a before/after dashboard snippet. Need quick review from obs + UX before merge.

safiya: Thanks! skimmed and left two inline comments: one wording nit and one about the Python snippet missing the client init (`client = RedwoodClient()`). I can patch wording if you want.

morgan: Please patch the wording. I'll add the client line. Also we should include a small before/after screenshot. @andrew do we have perms for docs assets?

andrew: Yeah, use `/assets/docs/console/cost-journey/`. I'll upload screenshots once copy is final. Pinging @li for the tracing hook compatibility note.

li: Quick note on the tracing hook: the runtime now spits trace ids with a `0x` prefix in some languages. The example uses a plain hex string. Suggest making the snippet robust: `trace_id = trace.id.hex()` (Python) or `strings.TrimPrefix(trace.ID.String(), "0x")` (Go). Also add a tiny sentence about how sampling rate affects the cost numbers in the dashboard.

safiya: :thumbsup: also please add a shell migration example for exporters — some customers still write dashboards off the old metric name `console.cost_per_token` -> `console.unit_cost`.

morgan: Draft shell snippet: ```bash
# dry-run rename of metric in exporter config
redwood-migrate --rename console.cost_per_token console.unit_cost --dry-run
```

li: Good start — add `--batch 500` so we don't hammer ingestion when customers run it live. Also add a short paragraph about remapping existing Grafana panels (search+replace metric names).

doc-bot: Automated check: linkchecker found 1 broken link in the PR (assets path). Status: fail. See details in CI.

andrew: I'll fix the assets path after I upload screenshots. Do we want to include a PromQL example for the cost rollup? Draft: ```promql
sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[5m])) by (service)
```

morgan: Yes include that, and add a short example panel JSON for users who import panels directly.

safiya: Small copy nit: change "latency-cost pairing" -> "cost/latency pairing" and use backticks around metric names.

andrew: :mag: LGTM after the fixes. Who will merge?

morgan: I'll merge once doc-bot passes and Andrew uploads the screenshots + alt text.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs.staging (branch docs/4278) — scheduled in ~10m.

andrew: Screenshots uploaded to /assets/docs/console/cost-journey/, added alt text and small 2px border for contrast. Fixed the broken asset link in PR.

doc-bot: All checks passed. Linkcheck OK. Spelling: 0 warnings. CI: green.

morgan: Merging now. Thanks everyone :rocket:
